short_description: 15A single pole switch in white, featuring Quickwire Push-In & Side wiring and 120 VAC operation.
long_description: The Leviton 1451-2W is a robust 15A single-pole switch, designed for reliable operation in commercial and industrial settings. This 120 VAC wiring device features both Quickwire Push-In and traditional side wiring terminals, facilitating efficient installation. Constructed from durable thermoplastic in a clean white finish, this 1-pole switch is built to last. It is UL and CSA certified, ensuring compliance with industry safety standards, and proudly manufactured in the USA, backed by a 2-Year Limited warranty.
